name: Amenorrhoea: Primary, Secondary and Turner, MRKH, Asherman

reference.source: Sakshi Arora Obstetrics E9 + Gynecology by Ten Teachers 21st Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Gonadal dysgenesis fibroses follicles raising gonadotropins while outflow walls block blood pooling; progesterone withdrawal bleeds only estrogenised patent tracts, and energy deficit silences GnRH pulsing starving ovaries reversibly.
additionalDifferentials: Outflow versus endocrine versus ovarian by challenge and FSH
Turner versus MRKH versus AIS by uterus and karyotype
Asherman versus hypothalamic by history and estrogen
